messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
A supported AI-related competitor comparison needs: formal R&S product/spec evidence for the Signaling / Non-signaling tester scope, official competitor or third-party evidence for the competitor claims, and AI-specific product evidence such as version, license, deployment, data handling, validation, and measured performance; current sales battle cards alone are not enough because they are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [11][12][13][14][22][24][47].
### Evidence required
For the R&S Signaling side, use formal CMX500 evidence: the CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and the relevant source documents are CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher [1][3].
For CMX500 software / signaling capability claims, cite the Features and Functions source only as a features overview, because that source states “Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding” and is not a technical specifications datasheet [3].
For CMX500 option-level claims, cite the actual option evidence, such as NR signaling enabler R&S CMX-KS600B / M / X, LTE signaling R&S CMX-KS500B / M / X, WLAN signaling options R&S CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS357B, and related NTN / RedCap signaling options only where those option codes are listed [39][60][61].
For the R&S Non-signaling side, use formal CMP200 evidence: CMP200 with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution for R&D and manufacturing RF parametric testing [5][7].
For CMP200 binding or warranted performance claims, cite the CMP200 Specifications Data Sheet PD 5216.4391.22 Version 08.00, August 2024, and respect its limitation that data without tolerance limits is not binding [6][7].
For CMP200 option-level claims, cite the actual listed options, such as R&S CMP-KM601 for NR FR2 measurements, R&S CMP-KM603 for multicarrier NR FR2 measurements, R&S CMP-KM605 for two RX antennas / switched MIMO, and R&S CMP-KW601 for NR mmWave waveform playback [64].
For competitor claims, do not rely only on R&S battle cards, because the Keysight, Anritsu, and amarisoft comparison pages explicitly say those pages are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [11][13][22].
For customer-facing competitor statements, add competitor official datasheets, official brochures, versioned option lists, or third-party evidence, because the Anritsu, Keysight, and amarisoft comparison pages say competitor claims from R&S internal battle cards need official or third-party verification before use in customer documents [12][14][24].
For AI-specific R&S claims, cite the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source only for what it states: it is an AI-powered scripting tool for the CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester that uses generative AI and natural language processing to generate, extend, and explain XLAPI scripts [43][46].
For AI-specific R&S claims, do not claim formal availability, license code, deployment type, model architecture, data residency, security controls, update validation, script accuracy, or supported CMX software release unless new evidence is added, because the current AI Scripting Assistant source does not provide those details [47].
retrieval boundary, model name, data protection, customer-data handling, or update validation process [44].
For AI market or AI-server claims, do not use the AISeverEcosystem mapping as a formal tester configuration or customer-fit proof, because it only records sales / testing solution leads and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [16].
For AI-server product mapping, do not infer that the listed companies bought, evaluated, adopted, or partnered with R&S, because the mapping page explicitly says company names in the same row as a solution do not imply purchase, evaluation, cooperation, deployment, visit, or R&S customer status [83].
For AI-related competitor comparison language such as “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar claims, do not use those as technical facts because the comparison pages identify such wording as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications [12][24].
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
R&S Signaling package: CMX500 specifications, CMX500 Features and Functions version, exact option codes, software version / CSW version, hardware configuration, measurement conditions, and which statements are binding versus non-binding [3][39][60][61].
R&S Non-signaling package: CMP200 specifications, CMP200 Features and Functions version, exact option codes, RRH / head configuration, measurement conditions, and which data has tolerance limits versus non-binding typical / nominal / measured values [4][6][7][64][66].
Competitor package: official competitor datasheets or brochures with document ID, version, date, option codes, software versions, hardware configurations, measurement conditions, and any third-party validation needed for claims that currently come only from R&S battle cards [12][14][24][30][33].
AI package: formal AI product documentation showing product name, version, license / order code, deployment options, security / data-handling model, update process, supported tester software release, validation method, and measured script-generation or automation performance, because the current CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source lacks those formal details [47].
Comparison package: a side-by-side matrix where every R&S and competitor cell traces to either formal R&S documents, official competitor documents, or third-party evidence, because the existing competitor pages cannot replace formal product specifications and battle-card claims need external verification [12][14][24].
### Current gap
The passages support separate facts about CMX500, CMP200, competitor battle-card limitations, and the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant, but they do not provide a fully supported AI-specific Signaling / Non-signaling Tester competitor comparison with formal competitor evidence and validated AI metrics [3][7][12][14][24][47].

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMP200 › Product data 使用限制
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

- Product data 適用條件為 ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且如適用需完成 all internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 代表保證的 product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、limit of、minimum 等形式標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）依 limits 測試，但因 measuring equipment 不可追溯至 national metrology standards，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證其 performance。
- Typical data（typ.）、nominal values（nom.）、measured values（meas.）均不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- Uncertainties 採 coverage factor 2，依 GUM 計算。
- 3GPP 標準中 chip rates 以 Mcps 表示，bit rates / symbol rates 以 Gbps、Mbps、kbps、Msps、ksps 表示，sample rates 以 Msample/s 表示；這些不是 SI units。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位

- has exclusive access to proprietary data from [[Rohde & Schwarz]]；
- has access to specialized resources derived from the expertise of [[Rohde & Schwarz]]；
- is trained with relevant data to optimize its performance；
- automatically integrates updates，以確保 users always have access to the most recent information and best practices。

限制：來源未說明 proprietary data 的範圍、資料版本、retrieval / training 分界、模型名稱、資料保護方式、客戶資料處理方式或 update validation 流程。

- [[XLAPI]] scripts；
- [[Python]]；

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱已開發 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]]，用於 automate test script generation and functional testing，對象是 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester。
- 工具使用 generative AI 與 natural language processing，目標是 streamlining workflows、reducing the risk of errors，以及 speeding up time-to-market。
- 來源描述的使用者痛點是：mobile device manufacturers 的 test engineers 需在時間壓力下，從多個來源手動彙整測試腳本輸入；來源列出的輸入包括 [[3GPP specifications]]、[[XLAPI]] scripts、[[Python]] 與 [[R&S CMX500]] user manual。

Virtual Signalling Tester
[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu 對 virtualized protocol stack test solution 的產品 / 解決方案語彙，核心是用 PC-based software protocol simulator 建立 NR / RedCap protocol test environment。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。

- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。

### Short answer
A supported AI-related competitor comparison needs: formal R&S product/spec evidence for the Signaling / Non-signaling tester scope, official competitor or third-party evidence for the competitor claims, and AI-specific product evidence such as version, license, deployment, data handling, validation, and measured performance; current sales battle cards alone are not enough because they are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [11][12][13][14][22][24][47].
### Evidence required
For the R&S Signaling side, use formal CMX500 evidence: the CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and the relevant source documents are CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher [1][3].
For CMX500 software / signaling capability claims, cite the Features and Functions source only as a features overview, because that source states “Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding” and is not a technical specifications datasheet [3].
For CMX500 option-level claims, cite the actual option evidence, such as NR signaling enabler R&S CMX-KS600B / M / X, LTE signaling R&S CMX-KS500B / M / X, WLAN signaling options R&S CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS357B, and related NTN / RedCap signaling options only where those option codes are listed [39][60][61].
For the R&S Non-signaling side, use formal CMP200 evidence: CMP200 with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution for R&D and manufacturing RF parametric testing [5][7].
For CMP200 binding or warranted performance claims, cite the CMP200 Specifications Data Sheet PD 5216.4391.22 Version 08.00, August 2024, and respect its limitation that data without tolerance limits is not binding [6][7].
For CMP200 option-level claims, cite the actual listed options, such as R&S CMP-KM601 for NR FR2 measurements, R&S CMP-KM603 for multicarrier NR FR2 measurements, R&S CMP-KM605 for two RX antennas / switched MIMO, and R&S CMP-KW601 for NR mmWave waveform playback [64].
For competitor claims, do not rely only on R&S battle cards, because the Keysight, Anritsu, and amarisoft comparison pages explicitly say those pages are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [11][13][22].
For customer-facing competitor statements, add competitor official datasheets, official brochures, versioned option lists, or third-party evidence, because the Anritsu, Keysight, and amarisoft comparison pages say competitor claims from R&S internal battle cards need official or third-party verification before use in customer documents [12][14][24].
For AI-specific R&S claims, cite the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source only for what it states: it is an AI-powered scripting tool for the CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester that uses generative AI and natural language processing to generate, extend, and explain XLAPI scripts [43][46].
For AI-specific R&S claims, do not claim formal availability, license code, deployment type, model architecture, data residency, security controls, update validation, script accuracy, or supported CMX software release unless new evidence is added, because the current AI Scripting Assistant source does not provide those details [47].

For AI market or AI-server claims, do not use the AISeverEcosystem mapping as a formal tester configuration or customer-fit proof, because it only records sales / testing solution leads and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [16].
For AI-server product mapping, do not infer that the listed companies bought, evaluated, adopted, or partnered with R&S, because the mapping page explicitly says company names in the same row as a solution do not imply purchase, evaluation, cooperation, deployment, visit, or R&S customer status [83].
For AI-related competitor comparison language such as “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar claims, do not use those as technical facts because the comparison pages identify such wording as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications [12][24].
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
